content: शार्दूलः [शॄ-ऊलल् दुक् च <ls>Uṇ. 4. 97</ls>] .²1 A tiger. .²2 A leopard or panther. .²3 A demon, {%Rākṣasa%}. .²4 A kind of bird. .²5 A kind of animal called शरभ. .²6 A lion. .²7 (at the end of <ab>comp.</ab>) An eminent or distinguished person, foremost; as in नरशार्दूल; <ab>cf.</ab> कुञ्जर.
